name: discord-chat
description: Two-way Discord channel via Gateway: pipeline notifications + chat commands (/status, /pause, /approve…) + freeform chat with native buttons (opt-in)

configSchema.label: Bot token
configSchema.help: Developer Portal → Bot → Token. Or {"$env":"DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN"}. Inbound needs the MESSAGE CONTENT INTENT toggle enabled.

configSchema.label: Notify channel IDs
configSchema.help: Comma-separated text-channel IDs that receive run notifications (right-click channel → Copy Channel ID with Developer Mode on).

configSchema.label: Allowed channel IDs (commands)
configSchema.help: Comma-separated channel IDs allowed to send commands. EMPTY = nobody: anyone in an allowed channel can control worca-cc.

configSchema.label: Allowed user IDs (optional)
configSchema.help: Comma-separated Discord user IDs (Developer Mode → right-click a user → Copy User ID). When set, only these people may send commands, even in an allowed chat; others are ignored. EMPTY = everyone in an allowed chat. In a group chat, /direct and the answer commands are only accepted from these people.

configSchema.label: /direct and answers in group chats
configSchema.help: /direct, /answer, /approve, /retry, /abort and /cancel steer a live run. listed users (default): in a group chat, only Allowed user IDs may use them (nobody when that is empty); direct messages to the bot always work. anyone: every member of an allowed group chat may.

configSchema.label: Listen filter (optional)
configSchema.help: Optional comma-separated channel IDs to listen on; empty = every channel the bot can read (commands are still gated by Allowed channel IDs).

configSchema.label: Freeform chat
configSchema.help: on: mentioning the bot in an Allowed channel opens a thread where a listed member chats with worca's Ask engine (paid model turns). Needs Freeform chat members. off (default): commands and notifications only.

configSchema.label: Freeform chat members
configSchema.help: Comma- or newline-separated discordUserId=worca identity pairs, e.g. 123456789012345678=ada@example.com. Only these people may start or continue a freeform chat or press its buttons. The identity is who worca records for their chats and runs (use their worca sign-in on a shared deployment, or local).

configSchema.label: Read recent history when a conversation starts
configSchema.help: Freeform chat: the first reply of a new conversation also reads this many messages of the channel before the mention (oldest first) and quotes them to the model as untrusted context, with their files. off (default): only the mention and the message it replies to. Read only in Allowed channels, never in direct messages; other bots' messages are skipped. Uses the Read Message History permission.

configSchema.label: Worca address for links (optional)
configSchema.help: Base address for Open in worca buttons, e.g. https://worca.example.com. Empty: messages name the chat instead of linking.
